arguments.summary: A critical credential compromise incident was detected involving the Finance OU. The external IP 185.220.101.42 conducted reconnaissance via an Nmap scan against an internal IT asset. Subsequently, lateral movement and pass-the-hash attacks led to the compromise of all 23 accounts in the Finance OU. Despite detection, automated credential revocation via IAM/PAM tools was denied due to policy and evidence validation constraints. No malware was found on initial analysis, but behavioral and SIEM data confirm active adversary presence.

timeline.description: External IP 185.220.101.42 performed Nmap SYN scan against internal host 10.0.2.15 (WS-IT-101). Detected and logged by IDS.
Successful authentication from compromised host (10.0.2.15) to domain controller as CORP\helpdesk. Initial access established.
Lateral movement observed from 10.0.2.15 to multiple Finance OU systems. Pass-the-hash attack confirmed via SIEM correlation.
UEBA system flags low-risk activity for user jdoe, but anomaly score remains below threshold. Missed detection opportunity.
Incident escalated after correlation of 23 authentication events linked to compromised Finance OU accounts.
Attempt to revoke 23 Finance OU credentials via IAM/PAM system (T8) failed due to policy restrictions and lack of approval.
